title: Min Stack
description: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant O(1) time.
input_format: First line contains integer `m`. Following `m` lines contain operations: `PUSH x`, `POP`, `TOP`, `GETMIN`.
output_format: Outputs of TOP and GETMIN separated by space.

sample_tests.input:
7
PUSH -2
PUSH 0
PUSH -3
GETMIN
POP
TOP
GETMIN
sample_tests.explanation: -3 is min, pop removes -3, top is 0, min is -2.

hints: Maintain a second stack `min_stk` alongside the primary stack.
On push(x), push min(x, min_stk[-1]) onto `min_stk`.
On pop(), pop from both stacks. `get_min()` simply returns `min_stk[-1]`.
